title: Bad description and picture
text: Bad description and picture. This gnome is described as a 17 inch fugue.  It looks like it is stuffed well. They shipped it in a 4 inch by 7 inch box. So basically it is a 6 inch gnome with an 11 inch hat. This thing is worse then any thing I've seen in a long time.
